1. DEFINITIONS
‘Availability Period’ means the period from 1 January 2027 to 31 December 2027.

2. INTEREST
2.1 The rate of interest is SONIA plus the Margin.
2.2 ‘Margin’ means 2.25 per cent per annum.

3. PREPAYMENT
3.1 The Borrower may prepay a Loan on five Business Days’ notice.
3.2 A prepayment must include accrued interest and may not be reborrowed.

4. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement and any non-contractual obligations arising out of it are governed by English law.

ARTICLE I — SCOPE
This Addendum applies to Personal Data processed for the Customer.

ARTICLE II — SECURITY
The Processor shall encrypt Personal Data in transit and at rest.
The Processor shall notify the Customer of a Personal Data Breach without undue delay and, in any event, within 24 hours after confirmation.

ARTICLE III — SUB-PROCESSORS
The Processor must give at least 30 days’ prior written notice before appointing a new Sub-processor.
The Customer may object on reasonable data-protection grounds.

queries.query: When must a confirmed personal data breach be notified?
answer_anchors: The Processor shall notify the Customer of a Personal Data Breach without undue delay and, in any event, within 24 hours after confirmation.

queries.query: What advance notice is required for a new sub-processor?
answer_anchors: The Processor must give at least 30 days’ prior written notice before appointing a new Sub-processor.

queries.query: Where must personal data be encrypted?
answer_anchors: The Processor shall encrypt Personal Data in transit and at rest.
